title: lomatium fusiformis
intro: Lomatium fusiformis, commonly known as Desert Biscuit Root or Porrum, is a perennial herb native to the northwestern United States and southwestern Canada. It is a member of the carrot family, Apiaceae, and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits. Lomatium fusiformis is reported to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it beneficial for treating various health conditions, including respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and pneumonia. The bioactive constituents of Lomatium fusiformis include sesquiterpene lactones, alkaloids, and other compounds, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
